title: define bootstrap and installer consumption boundary for hosted payload metadata

criteria: Installer states are defined and RC6 is limited to metadata/preflight states.
Verification order covers schema, RC5 binding, payload hashes, signature reference, revocation, freshness, compatibility, rollback, and storage policy.
Allowed outputs are local preflight/explanation evidence only.
Install, activation, rollback, active slot, production ring, support upload, remote dispatch, model replay, shell, and TUI side effects are forbidden.
